transport.title: Metro from Paris
transport.text: Metro line 14 runs directly to Orly Airport station from Châtelet, Gare de Lyon, Bercy and Saint-Lazare; the journey from central Paris takes about 25–35 minutes. A one-way Paris Région <> Airports ticket costs EUR 14: it can be bought from a ticket machine for Navigo Easy or through the Île-de-France Mobilités app. Alternatively, take RER B to Antony and then Orlyval; the journey from the centre takes about 35–45 minutes and also costs EUR 14.

storage.title: Baggage storage
storage.text: Bagages du Monde is in Orly 3 on Level 0 before security, near arrivals, and is open daily from 07:00 to 21:00. Baggage is X-rayed and stored under video surveillance; the price depends on size and storage duration. A cloakroom for accessories and special baggage, and stroller or child car seat rental, are also available.

kids.title: Baby rooms
kids.text: Baby-changing rooms in toilet facilities are open round the clock and have changing tables and children’s toilets. Separate baby rooms after security in Orly 3 and Orly 4 on Level 1 are free and open round the clock, with individual alcoves containing cots, seats, high chairs, bottle warmers and microwaves.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi and charging
wifi.text: The free WIFI-AIRPORT network is available in all terminals, boarding areas and baggage reclaim; after selecting it, open a browser to reach the connection page. Terminals have USB ports and European Type C, E and F sockets. Free lockable ChargeBox phone-charging compartments are available round the clock.
